description: Merged, voxel-downsampled cloud of the clean variant with stored normals. Per camera: back-project, crop, fit a plane on each sample's radius neighborhood in its own view, orient the normal toward that camera; then merge the views and average within voxels. Geometry only: no mass, friction or contact-patch information.
frame: W: right-handed, z up, metres, origin at the centre of the box
normalConvention: Unit normal facing the camera that observed the samples (outward on the visible faces of an opaque body). null where a cell has no stored normal (no valid sample normal, or its normals disagree).

processing.voxelRule: cell index k = floor(p/voxelSize + 0.5) per axis; cells are centred on integer multiples of voxelSize
processing.neighborRule: distance <= radius (inclusive, query included); if more than cap, the cap nearest; ties by lower sample index
processing.queryRule: among candidate pixels of the preset camera whose clean sample is inside the crop, the one whose clean sample is nearest to the target; ties by lower pixel index; sparse/noisy candidates are the kept pixels
